messages.author: b54b7f0bcb081ed1
messages.subject: ODBC error
parts: I am trying to use the RODBC library within rApache to connect to a MS SQL server using unixODBC and FreeTDS.  I have everything set up correctly and can succesfully connect to and execute queries against the database using isql.  I can also load R as root and run commands with RODBC without error.  However, when trying to run in rApache, it cannot connect to the database.  I get the errors "[unixODBC][FreeTDS][SQL Server]Unable to connect: Adaptive Server is unavailable or does not exist" and "Unable to connect to data source" in the apache error log.  Can anyone offer any advice why these would only fail in rApache?  Thanks!

messages.author: b54b7f0bcb081ed1
messages.subject: Re: ODBC error
parts:
This has been very frustrating.  I have spent 5 days and have even re-built the server 3 times trying to solve this problem.  ODBC/SQL server connections work fine everywhere outside of rApache.  Does anybody have any ideas where to start?  unixODBC won't even generate any log files for me to look at with the error in rApache.
 
Thanks,
Brad
